children: ACRES Commercial Realty launched two equity distribution programs, adding a $50 million common stock at-the-market (ATM) with Raymond James & Associates and a preferred stock ATM with Seaport Global Securities for up to 5,172,143 shares across its Series C and Series D preferred. The company also terminated its 2021 preferred ATM with Jones Trading, effective September 1, 2026. The new ATMs allow flexible issuance on the NYSE or via negotiated and block transactions, with commissions capped at 2.0%, to support liquidity and capital needs.
